sbdbCovariance.boundary: Horizons and SBDB nominal fit values are reconciled within one SBDB formal marginal sigma. This is not bitwise equality, proof of a shared covariance propagation, or a bound on systematic/model error.

model.uncertainty: JPL Horizons formal statistical state uncertainty; reported marginal one-sigma components in instantaneous RTN coordinates
model.correlation: The 2r vector response reports marginal sigmas but does not return cross-axis or cross-epoch covariance.
model.interpolation: Samples are source epochs only. Connecting or selecting samples does not define a continuous uncertainty envelope.
model.physicalBoundary: SPK/vector numerical interpolation precision is not orbit-solution accuracy; model error and uncertainty outside sampled epochs are not inferred.

vectorCorrection.selection: JPL Horizons API default; VEC_CORR was omitted from the frozen request
